sloka: अभिवाद्य च तत् भूतम् अद्भुतम् प्रिय दर्शनम् ।मुदा परमया युक्तः चकार अभिप्रदक्षिणम् ॥१-१६-२२॥
transliteration: abhivādya ca tat bhūtam adbhutam priya darśanam ।mudā paramayā yuktaḥ cakāra abhipradakṣiṇam ॥1-16-22॥

translations.english: Overwhelmed with great joy, he, walked around that wonderful being of pleasant countenance again and again and saluated him respectfully.
